title: Funding rate to next-hour BTC return diagnostic
claim: The latest causally available BTC funding rate improves the subsequent one-hour return forecast.
mechanism: Funding reflects directional positioning pressure that may resolve through subsequent price movement.
target: Next completed one-hour BTC candle open-to-close log return
informationSet: Latest funding observation available before the hourly boundary
primaryBaseline: Stronger of expanding historical mean and zero return

evidence.summary: Across 1,344 out-of-sample forecasts the candidate underperformed both controls; no sealed final holdout or executable basis leg was present.

nextAction: Do not treat funding alone as carry; accumulate synchronized basis, open-interest, liquidation, and execution state for distinct candidates.
